content.title: 76ers vs Boston Celtics Game 1 of NBA playoffs. How to watch, stream
content.text: Updated April 19, 2026, 12:23 p.m. ETThe Philadelphia 76ers will take on the Boston Celtics in the 2026 NBA playoffs, marking the 23rd time the franchises have met in the playoffs.Here's the series schedule of the first-round matchup between the hated rivals and how to watch Game 1.How Sixers clinched playoff spotThe Sixers defeated the Magic 109-97 in the NBA Play-In tournament in Philadelphia on April 15 thanks to a spectacular night by guard Tyrese Maxey, who led the team with 31 points and added six assists in 42 minutes.Rookie guard V.J. Edgecombe played like a veteran, scoring 19 points and leading the team with 11 rebounds in 42 minutes. Forward Kelly Oubre Jr. also chipped in 19 points and center Andre Drummond added 10 rebounds and two three pointers, including a dagger in the final minutes to seal the victory.76ers playoff schedule: Sixers vs Celtics Game 1Maxey, Edgecombe and veteran Paul George will take on Jayson Tatum, Jaylen Brown and the Boston Celtics in the first round of the NBA playoffs. Here are the details for Game 1.Date: Sunday, April 19Time: 1 p.m. ETLocation: TD Garden in BostonTV channel: ABCTickets: Get tickets for this game on StubHubWatch Philadelphia 76ers vs. Boston Celtics in NBA playoffs on FuboSixers tickets for playoffs on saleSeatGeek: Buy 76ers tickets on SeatGeekStubHub: Buy 76ers tickets on StubHubBuy Philadelphia 76ers playoff tickets on StubHunSixers-Celtics scheduleGame 1: Philadelphia at Boston | Sunday, April 19 (1 ET, ABC)Game 2: Philadelphia at Boston | Tuesday, April 21 (7 ET, NBC/Peacock)Game 3: Boston at Philadelphia | Friday, April 24 (7 ET, Prime Video)Game 4: Boston at Philadelphia | Sunday, April 26 (7 ET, NBC)Game 5: Philadelphia at Boston* | Tuesday, April 28Game 6: Boston at Philadelphia* | Thursday, April 30Game 7: Philadelphia at Boston* | Saturday, May 2*If necessarySixers vs Celtics last gameThe last time the Sixers played the Celtics was a blowout win by Boston on March 25.Celtics center Neemias Queta scored a career-high 27 points and added 17 rebounds to lead Boston, while Maxey led the 76ers with 33 points and six assists. Edgecombe added 23 points for Philly.The Sixers were playing without Joel Embiid and Paul George.Sixers-Celtics season seriesOct. 22: 76ers 117, Celtics 116Oct. 31: Celtics 109, 76ers 108Nov. 11: 76ers 102, Celtics 100March 25: Celtics 114, 76ers 98Will Joel Embiid play?Embiid is officially ruled out for Game 1 with his status for the series uncertain.In a cruel twist of fate, star center underwent an emergency appendectomy in Houston on April 9.The former NBA MVP was unable to play in the Play-In game against Orlando and his status for the Boston series is still in question. The team has not provided an update on his condition other then to confirm the surgery was successful.However, it was a good sign to see Embiid courtside with his teammates during the Sixers' game against the Magic.76ers injury report76ersJoel Embiid: Out (appendectomy)Johni Broome: Out (knee)CelticsNo injuries reportedWhen is the last time the Sixers played the Celtics in the playoffs?The last time came in 2023 when Embiid and then-Sixer James Harden lost in seven games to the Celtics, dropping the final game in Boston after failing to close out the second-round series in Game 6 at Philly.The last time the Sixers defeated the Celtics in the playoffs was in 1981-1982, when they won in Game 7 of the Eastern Conference Finals before losing to the Los Angeles in the NBA
